n372cc3618b.headline: Komnas HAM: Wages of Workers in Indonesia Lowest in Asia
n372cc3618b.summary: Komnas HAM commissioner Natalius Pigai said Indonesian worker wages fall into the lowest category in Asia. He called for Government Regulation No. 78 on wages to be revoked immediately.
n372cc3618b.why: Wage levels and wage regulation affect labor costs for manufacturers and consumer demand in Indonesia, a large emerging economy.
